body.description: SCIM resources serialization and validation with Pydantic

commits: fix: CoreUser has no attribute 'manager' when validating mutability

_decoded.interpretation: A ~4.5-hour, single-session private patch of the upstream SCIM2 Pydantic models library, made once on 2025-06-03 and never touched again (192 commits behind current upstream). The two commit messages (PatchOp model adjustment; CoreUser.manager mutability fix) are consistent with adapting the library to a real internal SCIM provisioning use case (e.g. consuming/serving SCIM from an HRIS/ATS integration such as Workday or SAP SuccessFactors) rather than idle exploration. Never published as its own PyPI package -- confirms Paradox uses SCIM internally but is not a corroborating 'Paradox publishes scim2-models' finding as the recon plan hypothesis had it.
